name: JTEC / Panaseer
summary: Managed telecoms/VPN provider: Panaseer services division of Jtec Pty Ltd (launched Feb 2000; parent Jtec from 1987, ex-AWA engineers); acquired by Commander Communications in Jan/Feb 2004.

events.details: Panaseer managed-services division of Jtec Pty Ltd launched Feb 2000 (national ATM backbone, NOC, >1,200 corporates, $8.5m contracted revenue at Jun 2000); parent Jtec founded 1987 by ex-AWA engineers.
Commander Communications acquired the Panaseer business (Jtec Pty Limited) from listed Panaseer Ltd (conditionally exchanged Jan 2004, completed ~16 Feb 2004).
